printers.name: Creality K2 Pro
printers.note: From Creality's K2 series comparison table. Siblings: K2 260x260x260, K2 Plus 350x350x350. One retailer (aio.lv) headline says 300x300x400; treated as an error.

printers.name: Creality K3
printers.note: Pre-order on Creality's store as of 2026-11-13 (USD 849, ships 'Early December'). Creality pages show only one K3; no K3 Pro/Plus/Max variant was found.

printers.name: Snapmaker U1
printers.note: 'UI' read as the U1, Snapmaker's 4-toolhead tool-changer. The spec page gives 270x270x270 and does not say whether any area is lost when several toolheads are used.

printers.name: Prusa CORE One+ (Gen 2) INDX
printers.note: Prusa's INDX 4-Tool page gives 248x205x270 (13.7 L); the 8-Tool version is sold under the same name. This is smaller than the plain CORE One+ at 250x220x270 (https://www.prusa3d.com/product/prusa-core-one/). Some retailers list 250x220x270 for the INDX model, which looks copied from the plain printer.

printers.name: Prusa CORE One L
printers.asked: Prusa x INDX Core One (larger CORE One L check)
printers.note: Larger sibling without INDX, 30 L. Prusa also sells it as 'CORE One L+'.

printers.name: Prusa CORE One L+ INDX
printers.asked: Prusa x INDX Core One (larger CORE One L check)
printers.note: Prusa says this is slightly smaller than the plain CORE One L+ because the tool dock takes space (about 27 L). Offered with 4 or 8 tools.

printers.name: Bambu Lab H3S
printers.note: No Bambu Lab H3S was found; searches return only the H2S. Almost certainly the H2S is meant (see bambu-lab-h2s).

printers.name: Bambu Lab H2S
printers.note: Single-nozzle sibling of the H2D. Source is TCT Magazine's launch report, because bambulab.com, the Bambu store and the Bambu wiki block automated fetches. Retailers give the same figure.

printers.name: Bambu Lab P2S
printers.note: Read from the 3D Printing Industry spec table. Bambu's own wiki FAQ (https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/p2s/manual/p2s-faq) blocks fetches; per search results it gives the same figure.

printers.name: Creality Ender-3 V2
printers.note: From the 3DJake product table. Creality's old product page no longer loads. The bed is about 235x235, but firmware limits printing to 220x220.

printers.name: Bambu Lab A1 mini
printers.note: Matches the existing figure. Bambu's own store blocks fetches, so a retailer is cited.

printers.name: Bambu Lab X1 Carbon
printers.note: Matches the existing figure. Cited from iFixit's device page because Bambu's pages block fetches.

printers.name: Bambu Lab H2D
printers.note: CORRECTION: the existing figure is wrong. The single-nozzle volume is 325x320x325. Printing with both nozzles gives 300x320x325. 350x320x325 is the total area across both nozzles, which no single nozzle can reach, so do not use it for one-nozzle prints.

printers.name: Creality Ender-3 V3
printers.note: Matches the existing figure. Creality's support page has no build volume. Do not confuse it with the Ender-3 V3 Plus (300x300x330) or the V3 SE/KE.
